description: Which sectors are gaining or losing share of a market's dollar volume: up to 5 each way over the last 5 or 20 sessions, each with its usual share and its share now and its × normal, then one line on the overall mix. Sectors as InfinityVolume shows them in each of the 13 markets. No prices or price changes.

market.description: Market key or name, e.g. US, Japan or Germany. Default US. Any of the 13 markets.

window.description: Sessions: 5 or 20 (or a week or a month). Default 5.

name: infinity_sector_rotation
title: Sector share shifts
